title: SpaceX Flies Last Falcon 9 Starlink Launch From Florida, Booster Sets 37-Flight Reuse Record
detail: SpaceX launched the Starlink 10-49 mission at 5:33 a.m. EDT (0933 UTC) on August 25, 2026 from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, deploying 29 V2-Mini Starlink satellites and marking the company's 100th Falcon 9 launch of 2026. Booster B1067 flew for the 37th time — a new reusability record, breaking its own prior 36-flight mark set in July 2026 — and landed on the droneship 'A Shortfall of Gravitas' in the Atlantic, the vessel's 165th landing and the 654th Falcon booster landing overall. Following the flight, SpaceX Vice President of Launch Kiko Dontchev confirmed it was the last planned Falcon 9 Starlink mission from Florida: roughly 260 Starlink launches have flown from Cape Canaveral since the first on May 23, 2019, but SpaceX is pivoting Florida Starlink deployment to Starship, dropping the Space Coast's monthly Falcon 9 cadence from eight or nine flights to roughly two (customer and government payloads). Vandenberg Space Force Base in California will absorb the Starlink workload for the remainder of 2026 and possibly longer.

media.caption: Falcon 9 lifts off carrying the Starlink 10-49 mission from Cape Canaveral, SpaceX's last planned Falcon 9 Starlink launch from Florida, August 25, 2026

title: SpaceX and Louisiana Announce $100B 'Starbase Louisiana' Spaceport in Vermilion Parish
detail: SpaceX and Louisiana Governor Jeff Landry announced plans on August 25, 2026 for a $100 billion Starship launch complex — 'Starbase Louisiana' — on roughly 125,000 acres of coastal marsh near Pecan Island in Vermilion Parish, about 50 miles southwest of Lafayette, between two state wildlife refuges. At full build-out the site would feature five launch complexes with two Starship towers each (10 pads total, each with its own propellant farm), plus propellant production, power generation, a deep-water port, an airport, and employee housing; Musk said the site could eventually host more than a dozen towers and over 30 Starship flights per day. Construction is targeted to begin in 2027 with a first launch as soon as 2029. SpaceX projects 3,000 direct jobs (average salary $92,600) plus roughly 8,100 indirect jobs, and Musk (via prerecorded video) and COO Gwynne Shotwell both spoke at the Abbeville announcement. Wildlife groups — including the Louisiana Wildlife Federation, National Wildlife Federation, and Pontchartrain Conservancy — immediately warned that the marsh hosts more than 300 bird species, including the critically endangered whooping crane, and urged the FAA not to waive environmental protections for the project; some Pecan Island residents said they learned of the plan only from news reports.

media.caption: SpaceX unveils plans for the $100 billion Starbase Louisiana spaceport in Vermilion Parish, August 25, 2026
